action: Accept Lisa Freeman's $49 micro-grant from the community center mutual aid fund to cover this month's Coursera subscription. Walk in to the community center or confirm by phone this week to formally accept. The cert is 22% done. Two months of real work went into it. Losing the subscription because I cannot afford $49 at zero savings would be one of those small financial decisions that costs a huge amount in momentum and sunk cost. Lisa offered it directly and it is conditional on me showing up — I already showed up in tick 7. This month the cert continues and I do not pay for it.
